rule: 报警≠定罪：所有自动标记（硬门禁违规、咨询性候选）都是候选发现，人工对照原始转录核实后才立案；误报记 falsePositives，人工发现而自动漏报记 falseNegatives；台账决定检查层级，误报率超标的检查从硬门禁降级为咨询性预筛（docs/evaluation/01-behavior-contract-and-rubric.md §6）。

entrySchema.date: ISO date of the human ruling
entrySchema.check: gate or advisory kind, e.g. hotline_not_whitelisted
entrySchema.evidence: what the human saw in the transcript
entrySchema.ruling: one sentence: why this is a scorer defect (FP) or a missed product defect (FN)
entrySchema.action: check revision / tier change / re-run status
